parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to run the BAYAREALIKE model with BiogeoBEARS, but I ran into this error:

> check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
Error: evaluation nested too deeply: infinite recursion / options(expressions=)?
Error during wrapup: evaluation nested too deeply: infinite recursion / options(expressions=)?

My dataset has 24 areas, for a tree with 24 species. Almost all species occur in only one area, and all areas (except two) have one species. I'm wondering if this error indicates that what I am trying to do is just not possible, due to the little overlap of the areas. I have been using distances between the areas to give the analysis more information, but that does not resolve the issue. Any suggestions?

I.e.:
* Make sure ALL species names have UNDERSCORES, NOT SPACES (see "sp_H IE16" versus "sp_H_IE16")
* Make sure there are NO spaces after each species name, just names
* NO tabs and NO spaces between the 0s and 1s

This format follows the PHYLIP format, originally used in C++ Lagrange. Using this format ensures that the same geography file can be used in C++ Lagrange, which is handy for double-checking the DEC model, etc.  Also, it is impossible to program something that can read any arbitrary format someone might come up with.
